questions.question: How many deaths from unintentional injuries were reported in California in 2017?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_leading_causes_of_death_us.csv')
result = int(df[(df['Year'] == 2017) & (df['State'] == 'California') & (df['Cause Name'] == 'Unintentional injuries')]['Deaths'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In 2017, which state experienced a higher age-adjusted death rate from unintentional injuries, California or Florida?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_leading_causes_of_death_us.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] == 2017) & (df['State'].isin(['California', 'Florida'])) & (df['Cause Name'] == 'Unintentional injuries')]
result = sub.sort_values(by='Age-adjusted Death Rate', ascending=False).iloc[0]['State']

questions.question: Did nationwide deaths from kidney disease exceed 35,000 in 1999?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_leading_causes_of_death_us.csv')
deaths = int(df[(df['Year'] == 1999) & (df['State'] == 'United States') & (df['Cause Name'] == 'Kidney disease')]['Deaths'].iloc[0])
result = 'yes' if deaths > 35000 else 'no'

questions.question: Among California, Florida, and New York, which two states had the highest number of deaths from unintentional injuries in 2017?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_leading_causes_of_death_us.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] == 2017) & (df['Cause Name'] == 'Unintentional injuries') & (df['State'].isin(['California', 'Florida', 'New York']))]
result = sub.sort_values(by='Deaths', ascending=False)['State'].head(2).tolist()

questions.question: What was the average age-adjusted death rate from unintentional injuries in 2017 across Delaware and Maryland?
